alternatives.description: Continue accepting public candidate findings through WP-005 without a machine validator for the new >=3-family Design Review Bundle boundary.
alternatives.projected_effect: Human/integrator discipline remains the only guard against malformed, stale, insufficiently reviewed, self-admitting or non-zero-cost bundles.
alternatives.risk: A future integration path could accidentally treat an under-reviewed public bundle as eligible candidate evidence.

alternatives.description: Add a deterministic v15.5/source-root-bound intake validator that verifies bundle hash, reviewer-family threshold, matching successful free calls, explicit zero cost and no self-admission before whole-source cross-reference.
alternatives.projected_effect: Public review output becomes machine-rejectable before private semantic consideration while retaining candidate-evidence-only status.
alternatives.risk: The validator checks transport/provenance structure, not the truth or adequacy of reviewer claims.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING has no executable enforcement of the new review threshold and zero-cost provenance at the public/private boundary.
The guard adds schema coupling and maintenance work, and still cannot substitute for five-file cross-reference or Garden/GSL admission.

assumptions: Public review bundles are untrusted candidate evidence until independently validated and cross-referenced.
Reviewer agreement and transport validity do not establish proof or authority.
reason.uncertainty: A structurally valid bundle may still contain correlated reasoning errors or incorrect semantic proposals; downstream whole-source review remains mandatory.
counterexamples: A bundle with only two independent families must be rejected.
A finding without a matching successful provider call must be rejected.
A successful call whose cost is absent or nonzero must be rejected.
A bundle that claims semantic admission must be rejected.
A bundle bound to another DesignEpoch/source root must be rejected.
reason.conclusion: Admit the deterministic intake guard only as a candidate-evidence eligibility boundary; preserve five-file cross-reference, ActionGate and human/canonical boundaries downstream.

obligations.statement: The validator rejects fewer than three independent/final reviewer families.
Reviewer findings/final dispositions must bind to matching successful :free provider calls with explicit zero cost.
Stale DesignEpoch/source-root and self-admitting bundles fail closed.
Passing intake remains non-authorizing and cannot modify canonical/current.

items.claim_scope: Public findings are candidate-only and require complete-source cross-reference.
Requires >=3 independent reviewers on the same target before semantic admission and zero-cost external inference.
Current private predecessor remains the authority/canonical baseline.
